hostContract.admission: Host explicitly supplies its existing write invoker; RPC constructs no adapter, policy, grant, ToolDefinition or executable
hostContract.recommendedComposition: ReadWriteTools.CreateInvoker(existingHostPolicy), retaining its configured file operations, path bounds and FileMutationQueue. Host must faithfully map write path/content to the same requested output; host transforms/hooks must not silently redirect or replace export contents.
hostContract.ownership: Invoker/renderer are borrowed, no disposal or host mutation. Output originals and existing dispatcher pending-command shutdown are joined.
hostContract.path: No implicit cwd/home/default filename, relative expansion or tilde expansion. Absolute input is normalized with Path.GetFullPath. Lexically normalized current source path is refused; aliases and containment remain the admitted host policy/file-adapter responsibility.
hostContract.write: Existing write adapter may create parent directories and overwrite the explicitly authorized output. Nonatomic writes have existing partial-effect semantics; cancellation/failure reports may-have-changed rather than rollback or publication certainty.
hostContract.metadata: Captured recorded prompt/declarations only; unrecorded dynamic runtime metadata and custom renderer callbacks remain outside scope.

limits: Native explicit absolute path and explicit policy-mediated host admission differ from upstream optional default/relative path and direct ambient writeFileSync
In-memory sessions and deferred unmaterialized file-backed sessions refused before write admission, matching pinned source preconditions
Static renderer profile: no interactive viewer/Markdown activation/inline images/theme discovery/custom extension HTML; no visual or byte parity
Output lifetime may end or fail after partial filesystem effects; no atomic publication/fsync/rollback claim
Only recorded system/tool metadata exported; no provider inference/current unrecorded runtime metadata capture
Fixed borrowed invoker policy/cwd/bounds remain host-owned across session replacement; no policy rebind or CLI installation
Input path length bounded at min(MaximumPromptCharacters,4096); renderer limits and existing writer limits also apply
regressionScope: 7 renderer groups after coordinator registers SessionHtmlRendererTests.Cases()
